errors.text_span: и показва всеки месец в този период
errors.evidence: The x-axis labels are for each year, not for each month. While the underlying data might be monthly or daily, the axis itself does not explicitly show months.

errors.text_span: достига връх от над 2100 през 2007 г.
errors.evidence: The peak of the blue line (SOFIX) is clearly below the 2000 mark on the left y-axis, at approximately 1950. A value of 'over 2100' is a significant overestimation.

errors.text_span: постепенно се покачва до около 600 през 2010 г.
errors.evidence: In 2010, the SOFIX index (blue line) is between 400 and 500. It does not reach 600 until around 2014.

errors.text_span: Червената линия (BG40) започва под 100 през 2001 г.
errors.evidence: The red line (BG40) does not start in 2001. It appears on the chart starting in 2005 at a value of approximately 200.

errors.text_span: бързо нараства до над 800 през 2007 г.
errors.evidence: The peak of the red line (BG40) in 2007 is approximately 450 on the right y-axis, which only goes up to 1000. 'Over 800' is a major factual error.

errors.text_span: спада рязко до под 100 през 2008 г.
errors.evidence: After its peak, the red line (BG40) drops to a low point of around 200, not 'under 100'.

errors.text_span: Колебанията ѝ продължават в тесен диапазон около 200 до 2021 г.
errors.evidence: The red line for the BG40 index stops around the year 2013. It does not continue to 2021.

errors.text_span: Зелената линия (BGBX40) започва близо до 0 през 2001 г., достига около 50 през 2007 г., спада до около 20 през 2008 г.
errors.evidence: The green line (BGBX40) does not exist before 2014. It starts in 2014 at a value of approximately 100. The entire description of its behavior from 2001 to 2014 is hallucinated.

errors.text_span: и се покачва постепенно до около 100 до 2021 г.
errors.evidence: The green line (BGBX40) starts around 100 in 2014 and ends at a value of approximately 150 in 2021, not 100.

errors.text_span: Всички линии показват значителни колебания през 2007 и 2008 г.
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect because the green line (BGBX40) did not exist in 2007 and 2008, so it could not have shown any fluctuations.
